prereq: Stage 1 的本地 MVP、两个任务族、审批、幂等、回执和恢复路径稳定。
已限定首位用户的真实邮箱、日历、文档或数据账户，并准备测试账户。
连接器只能申请最小范围；任何写入都必须有预览、审批和回执。
contracts: 来源与权限
每个 Source 记录账户、对象 ID、时间、范围、引用和撤销状态，任务不得越过授权范围。
连接器
OAuth 使用最小 scope 和短期凭据；同步具备游标、去重、限流和健康检查。
写入动作
邮件、日历、分享等写入必须经过 Connector Effect、Effect Preview、outbox 与 Receipt。
上下文边界
不同账户、项目和任务之间不串扰；最小必要内容进入 Context Pack。
不确定结果
超时、网络中断和外部状态未知时先对账，不能直接重复发送或写入。
failures: 任务显示重连要求，保留草稿和已完成步骤。
重新授权后继续，不重放已成功的外部动作。
网页内容试图扩大权限
任务暂停并提示内容不可信，要求用户确认。
丢弃注入指令，保留来源证据并重新生成安全计划。
显示“等待对账”，不显示成功或允许盲目重试。
查询测试账户或外部系统，确认后补写回执或执行补偿。
exclusions: 不在一个连接器上证明权限、幂等和回执之前扩展多个渠道。
不自动执行高风险提交、公开发布或不可逆分享。
不让网页内容、附件或模型输出直接改变权限。

prereq: Stage 1's local MVP, two task families, approval, idempotency, receipts, and recovery are stable.
A real email, calendar, document, or data account is scoped for the first user, with a test account available.
Connectors request least privilege only; every write has preview, approval, and a receipt.
contracts: Sources and authority
Every Source records account, object ID, time, scope, citation, and revocation state; tasks never exceed authorized scope.
Connectors
OAuth uses least-privilege scopes and short-lived credentials; sync has cursors, deduplication, rate limits, and health checks.
Write actions
Email, calendar, and sharing writes pass through Connector Effect, Effect Preview, outbox, and Receipt.
Context boundary
Accounts, projects, and tasks never leak into each other; only the minimum necessary content enters a Context Pack.
Uncertain results
Timeout, network loss, or unknown external state requires reconciliation before retry.
failures: A connector expires or is revoked
The task asks for reconnection and preserves drafts and completed steps.
Reauthorize and continue without replaying successful external actions.
Page content tries to expand authority
The task pauses, marks the content as untrusted, and asks the user to confirm.
Drop the injected instruction, preserve source evidence, and regenerate a safe plan.
The UI shows Reconciling, neither success nor blind retry.
Query the test account or external system, then write a receipt or compensate.
exclusions: Do not expand channels before one connector proves permission, idempotency, and receipt behavior.
Do not automatically perform high-risk submissions, public publishing, or irreversible sharing.
Do not let page content, attachments, or model output change authority.

zh.title: 只读连接器与来源视图
zh.lead: 先用一个真实连接器证明权限、来源和撤销边界，再讨论写入与多渠道。
zh.outcome: 用户可以连接一个真实邮箱、日历或文档账户，让 Hearth 读取指定范围，并在任务卡上看到来源、时间和原始引用。
steps: 先接一个 Connector，使用 OAuth 最小授权范围与短期凭据。
实现 Source 归一化、去重、游标、限流和过期处理。
建立来源投影与来源详情 UI，显示账户、对象、时间和引用范围。
加入连接器健康页、断开与撤销入口，并让撤销立即影响后续读取。
用真实但脱敏的对象演示一次只读研究任务，不暴露原始凭据。
确认任务只引用被授权范围，且每个来源都能追溯到原始对象。
zh.gate: 只读同步可用；用户能撤销连接；任务只引用被授权范围；来源可追溯到原始对象；UI 不暴露原始凭据。
evidence: 来源投影与来源详情页

en.title: Read-only connector and source view
en.lead: Prove permission, provenance, and revocation with one real connector before discussing writes or multiple channels.
en.outcome: A user connects one real email, calendar, or document account, lets Hearth read a scoped range, and sees source, time, and original citation on the task card.
steps: Connect one Connector with least-privilege OAuth scopes and short-lived credentials.
Implement Source normalization, deduplication, cursors, rate limits, and expiry handling.
Build source projection and detail UI showing account, object, time, and citation scope.
Add connector health, disconnect, and revoke actions; revocation immediately affects later reads.
Demonstrate one read-only research task with real, redacted objects without exposing raw credentials.
Confirm tasks cite only authorized scope and every source traces back to the original object.
en.gate: Read-only sync works; users can revoke the connection; tasks reference only authorized scope; sources trace to originals; the UI exposes no raw credentials.

zh.title: Document/Data Executor
zh.lead: 把确定性文档处理从模型中拿出来，用可验证的数据管道处理 PDF、Office 文档和表格。
zh.outcome: 用户可以把 PDF、Office 文档和表格变成结构化报告、对比表或可复现转换结果，并查看文件差异。
steps: 建立 Python sidecar，隔离解析、OCR、格式转换、表格清洗与导入导出。
实现确定性管道，能不用模型完成的步骤不交给模型。
使用内容寻址产物，保存原文件、转换参数、哈希和来源。
加入表格结构、数值、公式和链接验证，避免只检查文件是否存在。
实现 artifact diff、预览和大文件分块处理，避免把全文塞入上下文。
失败时保留原文件与中间状态，允许单独重跑解析或转换步骤。
zh.gate: 至少三种常见文档格式可处理；确定性步骤不经过模型；结果可验证；大文件不把全文塞入上下文；失败时保留原文件。

en.title: Document/Data Executor
en.lead: Move deterministic document work out of the model and into a verifiable data pipeline for PDFs, Office files, and spreadsheets.
en.outcome: Users turn PDFs, Office files, and spreadsheets into structured reports, comparisons, or reproducible conversions and inspect file diffs.
steps: Build a Python sidecar that isolates parsing, OCR, format conversion, table cleaning, import, and export.
Implement a deterministic pipeline; steps that do not need a model never call one.
Use content-addressed artifacts that preserve originals, conversion parameters, hashes, and provenance.
Validate table structure, numbers, formulas, and links instead of checking only that a file exists.
Add artifact diff, preview, and chunked handling for large files so the entire document never enters context.
On failure, preserve original files and intermediate state so a parse or conversion step can rerun alone.
en.gate: Three common document formats work; deterministic steps avoid the model; results validate; large files avoid full-context dumps; originals survive failures.

zh.title: Browser Executor 与网页研究
zh.lead: 让浏览器成为可观察、可接管的研究工具，同时把网页内容视为不可信输入。
zh.outcome: 用户可以让 Hearth 打开网页、收集来源、下载授权文件、填写非高风险表单草稿，并在需要验证码时接管。
steps: 建立 Playwright worker，隔离浏览器 profile 与登录态边界。
把页面内容视为不可信，加入提示词注入防护和域名/网络出口策略。
实现截图、来源清单、下载验证和页面不可用时的降级。
提供实时接管入口，用户处理验证码、登录或复杂交互后可以交还。
对表单提交分级：草稿可自动填写，高风险提交必须审批。
验收代表性研究任务，确认内容不能直接扩大权限或触发外部写入。
zh.gate: 代表性研究任务有可追溯来源；网页内容不能直接扩大权限；下载文件经过验证；高风险提交不自动执行；接管后状态可继续。

en.title: Browser Executor and web research
en.lead: Make the browser an observable, takeover-ready research tool while treating web content as untrusted input.
en.outcome: Users can open pages, collect sources, download authorized files, fill low-risk form drafts, and take over when a CAPTCHA appears.
steps: Build a Playwright worker and isolate browser profiles and login state boundaries.
Treat page content as untrusted; add prompt-injection defenses and domain/network egress policy.
Implement screenshots, source lists, download verification, and degradation when a page is unavailable.
Provide live takeover so users handle CAPTCHA, login, or complex interaction and then hand back.
Tier form submission: drafts may autofill, but high-risk submission requires approval.
Accept representative research tasks and confirm content cannot directly expand authority or trigger writes.
en.gate: Research tasks have traceable sources; page content cannot expand authority; downloads verify; high-risk submissions never auto-run; takeover resumes safely.

zh.title: 草稿、审批与测试账户副作用闭环
zh.lead: 第一次让真实连接器产生外部写入，但只使用测试账户，并证明预览、审批、回执和对账能够闭合。
zh.outcome: 用户看到邮件草稿、日历变更或文档分享的完整预览，可以批准或拒绝，并在之后查看回执。
steps: 实现邮件草稿、日历冲突检查和待审批写入、文档导出/分享。
接入真实 Connector Effect，但全部在测试账户和受限收件人上运行。
用 Effect Preview 展示收件人、时间、内容、范围和撤销/补偿说明。
把审批、outbox 重投、Receipt 对账和失败死信串成完整链路。
验证审批与真实参数绑定，旧审批不能用于新动作。
至少演练一次重复投递、超时和不确定结果，确认不会重复发送或写入。
zh.gate: “读取 → 理解 → 起草 → 审批 → 执行 → 回执”闭环可用；测试账户无重复发送/写入；不确定结果先对账；审批绑定真实收件人、时间、内容和范围。
evidence: 邮件/日历/文档测试账户闭环
重复投递与不确定结果演练

en.title: Drafts, approvals, and test-account effects
en.lead: Let a real connector produce its first external writes, using test accounts only, and prove preview, approval, receipt, and reconciliation close.
en.outcome: Users see a complete email draft, calendar change, or document-share preview, can approve or reject it, and later inspect the receipt.
steps: Implement email drafts, calendar conflict checks and pending writes, and document export/share.
Connect real Connector Effects but run only on test accounts and restricted recipients.
Use Effect Preview to show recipient, time, content, scope, and undo or compensation.
Connect approval, outbox redelivery, Receipt reconciliation, and dead letters end to end.
Verify approval binds to real parameters and an old approval cannot authorize a new action.
Rehearse duplicate delivery, timeout, and uncertain results and confirm no duplicate send or write.
en.gate: Read → understand → draft → approve → execute → receipt works; no duplicate test-account effects; uncertainty reconciles first; approval binds recipient, time, content, and scope.

zh.title: Context Compiler、Token Governor v1 与 Memory v0
zh.lead: 在任务变多之后，用上下文编译、预算控制和最小记忆维持质量与成本，而不是把所有材料都塞给模型。
zh.outcome: 常见任务有模板，任务卡更简洁；系统能记住用户明确认可的偏好和事实，并说明为什么召回。
steps: 实现 Context Compiler，按任务裁剪来源、证据和工具结果。
加入 Token Governor 预算、阶梯路由、缓存、异常停止和成本解释。
实现 Episodic + Semantic Memory v0，记录 provenance、敏感度和基础遗忘。
建立任务模板和产物中心，减少重复输入但不跳过验收。
提供记忆查看、纠正和删除入口，显示召回原因。
验证跨账户、跨项目不串扰，并对比人工分钟与 Token。
zh.gate: 常见任务人工分钟下降且 Token 可解释；跨账户/跨项目不串扰；用户能查看、纠正和遗忘记忆；模板不会跳过验收。

en.title: Context Compiler, Token Governor v1, and Memory v0
en.lead: As tasks grow, preserve quality and cost through context compilation, budget control, and minimal memory instead of sending everything to the model.
en.outcome: Common tasks have templates and cleaner cards; the system remembers explicitly accepted preferences and facts and explains why it recalled them.
steps: Implement Context Compiler to trim sources, evidence, and tool results per task.
Add Token Governor budgets, tiered routing, caching, abnormal stops, and cost explanations.
Implement Episodic + Semantic Memory v0 with provenance, sensitivity, and basic forgetting.
Create task templates and an artifact center that reduce repeated input without skipping acceptance.
Provide memory view, correction, deletion, and recall explanations.
Verify account and project isolation, then compare manual minutes and Token usage.
en.gate: Common-task minutes fall and Token is explainable; accounts and projects stay isolated; users can view, correct, and forget memory; templates never skip acceptance.

zh.title: Stage 2 发布
zh.lead: 把研究、邮件、日历、文档和网页任务放进日常使用，并确认来源、审批、回执和隐私边界同时成立。
zh.outcome: Hearth 成为可处理研究、邮件、日历、文档和网页任务的日常操作员。
steps: 用代表性真实任务跑完整阶段，覆盖只读、文档、浏览器和测试账户写入。
补齐失败分类、连接器降级、数据导出和隐私说明。
对比 Stage 1 基线，记录人工分钟、成功率、Token 与失败类型。
检查跨账户数据串扰、来源可追溯性和审批参数绑定。
完成 Stage 2 安全与评测报告，列出仍不能自动执行的高风险动作。
确认用户能理解每个外部动作的来源和回执，并愿意继续日常使用。
zh.gate: Stage 2 退出条件全部满足；至少一个真实测试账户闭环稳定；不出现跨账户数据串扰；用户能理解每个外部动作的来源和回执。
evidence: 与 Stage 1 基线的对比

en.title: Stage 2 release
en.lead: Put research, email, calendar, document, and web tasks into daily use while proving provenance, approval, receipts, and privacy boundaries together.
en.outcome: Hearth becomes a daily operator for research, email, calendar, document, and web tasks.
steps: Run representative real tasks across read-only, documents, browser, and test-account writes.
Complete failure classes, connector degradation, data export, and privacy guidance.
Compare with the Stage 1 baseline for minutes, success, Token, and failure types.
Check cross-account leakage, source traceability, and approval parameter binding.
Publish the Stage 2 safety and evaluation report with remaining high-risk exclusions.
Confirm users understand the source and receipt of every external action and want to keep using it.
en.gate: All Stage 2 exits hold; one real test-account loop is stable; no cross-account leakage occurs; users understand every external action's source and receipt.
